platforms.name: Claude Desktop 'Cowork' sessions (Windows/macOS)

methods.howItWorks: CONFIRMED on disk 2026-10-15 (Claude Desktop, Windows; 264 transcript files, 220 audit.jsonl). Cowork transcripts live ONLY under %APPDATA%\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions\<orgId>\<userId>\<sessionDir>\.claude\projects\<slug>\<cliSessionId>.jsonl — sessionDir is local_<uuid> (newer builds; slug derived from the session cwd) or an 8-hex id (Feb-Apr 2026 builds; slug 'session'); lines carry entrypoint 'local-agent'. They are NOT under ~/.claude/projects, which holds Code-tab / CLI / Agent SDK sessions only. Lines are the Claude Code transcript format (type assistant|user|system|attachment|queue-operation|last-prompt); assistant lines carry message.model and the same message.usage fields as Claude Code {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation{ephemeral_5m_input_tokens, ephemeral_1h_input_tokens}, server_tool_use, service_tier, inference_geo, iterations, speed} plus top-level uuid, requestId, sessionId, cwd, timestamp, version. Each <sessionDir> also has audit.jsonl (HMAC-chained; types assistant|user|system|result|rate_limit_event) whose result lines carry total_cost_usd, usage{...} and modelUsage{<model>: {inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, costUSD, canonicalModel, provider}}, num_turns, duration_ms. Roots: standard app %APPDATA%\Claude (3P/BYO-provider edition %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude-3p); macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/local-agent-mode-sessions/. Official docs confirm local-agent-mode-sessions/ holds Cowork (and 3P Chat) history and audit.jsonl. The dashboard's collector ('local' tool = ~/.claude only) and folder scanner therefore MISS Cowork today.

(b) LiteLLM proxy: GET /key/info?key= -> {key, info{token, spend (USD), expires, models, max_budget...}}; GET /spend/logs?start_date&end_date (rows: api_key, user, team_id, model_group, spend, total_tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, request_id) and paginated /spend/logs/v2; GET /user/daily/activity -> results[{date, metrics{spend, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, api_requests}, breakdown{models, providers, api_keys}}]; GET /global/spend/report; response header x-litellm-response-cost. platforms.name: Cursor (IDE + cursor-agent CLI)

methods.howItWorks: Undocumented, reverse-engineered. Global store: Windows %APPDATA%\Cursor\User\globalStorage\state.vscdb (macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb; Linux ~/.config/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb). SQLite with two tables: ItemTable (key/value; `cursorAuth/accessToken` JWT, `composer.composerHeaders`, legacy `workbench.panel.aichat.view.aichat.chatdata`) and cursorDiskKV (keys `composerData:<composerId>` = conversation metadata, `bubbleId:<composerId>:<bubbleId>` = one message blob, plus `agentKv` blobs for newer agent sessions; the DB is routinely multi-GB and WAL-locked while Cursor runs). Per-workspace: Cursor\User\workspaceStorage\<hash>\state.vscdb ItemTable key `composer.composerData` (in recent builds only `selectedComposerIds` + migration flags; the per-workspace composer list moved to `composer.composerHeaders`). Token fields: the open-source CodeBurn parser finds that no bubble carries a real `tokenCount` (it stays {0,0}), `composerData.usageData` is an empty object and 'Cursor v3 reports zero token counts', so it estimates tokens as chars/4; agent-walker likewise states Cursor keeps no per-request token counts on disk. Model name is present on bubbles/composers in some versions only; no cost. cursor-agent CLI: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\projects\<projectId>\agent-transcripts\ (legacy *.txt, Composer-2 JSONL), %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\chats\<hash>\<agentId>\store.db (blobs + protobuf roots), %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ai-tracking\ai-code-tracking.db (table conversation_summaries) — again no token fields, estimation only.

Admin API (Teams/Enterprise only; no personal-usage API for Pro/Hobby). Key from cursor.com/dashboard (user API key) or team settings (service-account key); HTTP Basic auth with the key as username and empty password (`-u KEY:`). POST https://api.cursor.com/teams/filtered-usage-events {startDate,endDate (epoch ms), userId|email|serviceAccountId|cloudAgentId|automationId|hostingType, page, pageSize<=1000} -> usageEvents[]{timestamp (epoch-ms string), userEmail, conversationId, model, kind ('Usage-based' etc.), maxMode, requestsCosts, isTokenBasedCall, isChargeable, isHeadless, tokenUsage{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheWriteTokens, cacheReadTokens, totalCents, discountPercentOff}, chargedCents, cursorTokenFee}; 60 req/min/team. POST /teams/daily-usage-data {startDate,endDate (<=30 days), page, pageSize} -> data[]{userId,email,day,date,isActive,totalLinesAdded/Deleted,acceptedLinesAdded/Deleted,totalApplies,totalAccepts,totalRejects,totalTabsShown,totalTabsAccepted,composerRequests,chatRequests,agentRequests,cmdkUsages,bugbotUsages,subscriptionIncludedReqs,apiKeyReqs,usageBasedReqs,mostUsedModel,applyMostUsedExtension,tabMostUsedExtension,clientVersion} — no token or cost fields; 20 req/min/team. Also POST /teams/spend (per-member spendCents) and GET /teams/members. CORS: live preflight (2026-10-15) returns `Vary: Origin` and echoes `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` only for https://cursor.com; for Origin: null / localhost / arbitrary origins no allow-origin header is returned -> blocked from file://, must go through the local collector helper.

platforms.name: Zed (Agent Panel)

methods.howItWorks: Agent threads are stored in one SQLite file: Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\Zed\threads\threads.db; macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Zed/threads/threads.db; Linux ~/.local/share/zed/threads/threads.db. Table `threads` (one row per thread): id, summary, updated_at, data_type ('zstd' = zstd-compressed JSON, 'json' = legacy uncompressed), data (blob). Decompressed thread JSON (version 0.1.0/0.2.0/0.3.0) carries `model: {provider, model}`, `request_token_usage`: map of user-message id -> {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens} (zero-valued fields omitted; does not cover every request), and `cumulative_token_usage` with the same shape for the whole thread; no per-request timestamps (only thread updated_at) and no cost field. Zstd decompression is needed in-page (e.g. fzstd WASM/JS) since the browser has no native zstd. Text threads (legacy assistant) are plain JSON under Zed/conversations/. Zed's storage migration to SQLite+zstd is commit #31741.

methods.howItWorks: A local token log exists ONLY with the official opt-in OpenTelemetry file exporter (CONFIRMED by the VS Code docs, verifier 2026-10-15). (1) VS Code settings `github.copilot.chat.otel.enabled: true`, `github.copilot.chat.otel.exporterType: "file"` (values otlp-http (default) | otlp-grpc | console | file), `github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile: "<path>"` -> JSON-lines of traces/metrics/events; `chat` spans (one per LLM call) carry gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens; `invoke_agent` root span has session totals; metric gen_ai.client.token.usage; events gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details and copilot_chat.agent.turn. `github.copilot.chat.otel.dbSpanExporter.enabled: true` instead writes spans to a local SQLite (agent-traces.db, table assistant_usage_events: input_tokens (cache-inclusive), output_tokens, total_nano_aiu, request_multiplier, created_at). Env equivalents: COPILOT_OTEL_ENABLED, COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH. (2) Without OTel there is NO token data: the VS Code chat journals %APPDATA%\Code\User\workspaceStorage\<hash>\chatSessions\*.jsonl and globalStorage\emptyWindowChatSessions\*.jsonl exist on disk (verified here, 2 workspaces) but carry NO token fields — the CodeBurn claim of result.metadata.promptTokens / outputTokens / modelTotals / copilotCredits was NOT reproduced; they are history/text only (estimation at best). Transcripts in workspaceStorage\<hash>\GitHub.copilot-chat\transcripts\ likewise carry no usage. (3) Copilot CLI (already a card): %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\session-state\<id>\events.jsonl (assistant.usage; session.shutdown modelMetrics) and ~/.copilot/session-store.db; CLI OTel defaults to exporter type `file` (COPILOT_OTEL_EXPORTER_TYPE).
